payload.text: ST0002 WP04. AC-04.1's local half is measured and accepted by vc. bin/devbin formula render exits 0 with nothing typed (a local tag in the scratch clone, stand-in sums). brew style and brew audit --strict each fail on one line only, devbin's generated manifest header (lib/cmd/formula:424, 131 of 118 columns), and both pass with that header one element per line. Released in parts. The style and audit halves are released when devbin ships that fix: the issue text for hv is on the local branch dc/devbin-issue (84972b4), vc hold 2 item 7. The signature half is released when Developer ID signing exists, vc hold 2 item 3. Then the AT, citing each half's evidence. AC-04.2 (the tap's description and CI) needs hv's gh repo edit and a tap push
